race.description: Kosciuszko Tickets At Tab Highway Hcp (C2)
race.comment: BOMBAY BOOM (7) knocked up late on his return with a respectable fifth over 1000m at this track in a fast run contest. Comes to hand quickly and can finish much closer today from another good draw. BELLERATA (13) making good progress in weaker company and deserves her chance in town third up. Sprinted quickly to remain undefeated this time in with a slick win over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Will stalk the solid tempo and can hold her own against this lot. MAGIC SPEED (10) wound up strongly from back in the field first up to secure third over 1000m at this track. Looks set for a good campaign and gets a similar set-up. Respect. BUZZ SAW (8) in career best form and worth more than a passing glance at the big odds. The chances don't end there.
